blind.description: An ornate, low rectangular footstool featuring a plush, tufted or padded red velvet cushion trimmed with small gold or brass studs around the bottom perimeter. The cushion rests on a dark carved wooden frame supported by four short, curved cabriole-style legs that sit cleanly on the floor.
blind.from_above: A neat red rectangular cushion with subtle texture, bordered by a wooden edge with decorative studs, showing a slight shadow to one side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall (roughly 1/5 to 1/6 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
